title: When Helpful Agents Cause Financial Harm: Evaluating LLM Agent Safety in Executable Economic Worlds
abstract: arXiv:2611.18612v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As LLM agents become increasingly capable of making consequential economic decisions, their safety under economic pressures remains poorly understood. We introduce EconSafeBench, the first benchmark for systematically evaluating the safety of LLM agents in executable economic environments. EconSafeBench contains 828 cases across five economic scenarios and four categories of safety violations. A key design is the matched evaluation of three sources of safety pressure, including explicit user requests, pressure from other actors, and pressure arising from the agent's own pursuit of a performance objective. We further evaluate safety at both static and dynamic scales through 30-period interactions with persistent memory and matched controls. translated_title: 当有用智能体造成经济损失时：在可执行经济世界中评估LLM智能体安全性
translated_abstract: 随着LLM智能体日益具备做出重大经济决策的能力，它们在经济压力下的安全性仍然鲜为人知。我们提出了EconSafeBench，这是首个用于系统性评估LLM智能体在可执行经济环境中安全性的基准。EconSafeBench包含828个案例，涵盖五个经济场景和四类安全违规行为。其关键设计是对三种安全压力来源进行匹配评估，包括明确的用户请求、来自其他参与者的压力，以及智能体自身追求绩效目标所产生的压力。我们进一步通过带有持续记忆和匹配对照组的30周期交互，在静态和动态两个尺度上评估安全性。在八个LLM中，所有被评估模型在静态基准上均表现出安全违规，总体违规率介于8.5%至40.6%之间。我们进一步发现，即使……违规也可能发生
tldr: 提出首个在可执行经济环境中系统评估LLM智能体安全性的基准EconSafeBench，发现所有被测模型在用户请求、他人压力及自身绩效目标等不同经济压力来源下均存在8.5%至40.6%的安全违规率。
en_tdlr: EconSafeBench is introduced as the first benchmark for systematically evaluating LLM agent safety in executable economic environments, revealing that all tested models exhibit safety violations (ranging from 8.5% to 40.6%) under matched pressures from user requests, other actors, and the agent's own performance objectives.
